rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for putting seeds or plants into soil so they can grow.

example.english: We plant herbs on the balcony today.
example.traditional: 我哋今日喺露台種香草。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 hai2 lou6 toi4 zung3 hoeng1 cou2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for a living plant.

example.english: This plant is easy to look after.
example.jyutping: ni1 fo2 zik6 mat6 hou2 ji6 daa2 lei5

rows.note: Use this for a factory or production facility, especially one described as being in a particular country or location.

example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 cong2 hai2 sam1 zan3

rows.traditional: 放 A 喺 B 度屈 C
rows.jyutping: fong3 A hai2 B dou6 wat1 C
rows.note: Use this construction when an object is placed somewhere as evidence or bait to frame C.

example.english: They plant a phone in my bag to frame me for stealing.
example.traditional: 佢放部手機喺我個袋度屈我偷嘢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 fong3 bou6 sau2 gei1 hai2 ngo5 go3 doi6 dou6 wat1 ngo5 tau1 je5

rows.note: Use this in an industrial context for the machinery and other equipment used in production or construction.

example.english: This plant equipment needs regular inspection.
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 cit3 bei6 jiu3 ding6 kei4 gim2 caa4

rows.note: Use 插 when something such as a flag or stake is pushed firmly into the ground or another surface.

example.english: The workers plant the flag in the soil.
example.jyutping: gung1 jan4 zoeng1 zi1 kei4 caap3 jap6 nai4 tou2

rows.note: Use this for the slice where someone plants or firmly sets their feet.

example.english: Plant your feet firmly before you fight me.
example.traditional: 你企穩對腳先好同我打交。
example.jyutping: nei5 kei5 wan2 deoi3 gok3 sin1 hou2 tung4 ngo5 daa2 gaau1

rows.note: Use this for an undercover agent operating among ordinary members of the public.

example.english: The police sent a plant to blend in with that group.
example.traditional: 警方派咗個臥底混入嗰班人。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 paai3 zo2 go3 ngo6 dai2 wan6 jap6 go2 baan1 jan4
